Create a production-ready 2x2 interactive mascot atlas for a premium portrait mobile slot game. EXACTLY FOUR distinct original fictional mascots, arranged in a mathematically precise uniform 2-column by 2-row grid. One complete mascot centered in each equal-sized cell, equal visual scale, consistent three-quarter front camera, cohesive proportions and lighting. Full bodies visible, no cropping, no overlap, minimum 10% clear background padding around every mascot, clean readable silhouettes at small UI size.

BACKGROUND: the entire canvas must be one perfectly flat, uniform electric blue chroma-key color #0000FF. No grid lines, separators, gradient, texture, floor, horizon, cast shadows, ambient scenery, vignette, or blue rim light. Hard clean subject edges. Absolutely no blue anywhere in the mascots, props, reflections, or lighting.

TOP LEFT: tiny pearl fortune fairy, joyful and friendly, cute refined proportions, original design, cream-and-champagne satin outfit, subtle pearl ornamentation, delicate small wings in pearl-white/cream tones, holding exactly one luminous realistic pearl. Warm smile, soft inviting pose, luxury fortune energy, not solemn.

TOP RIGHT: cheerful chibi Chinese God of Wealth-inspired fortune mascot, respectful and fully original, fictional non-photoreal character, friendly round face and joyful expression, wearing a soft wine-red and champagne-gold festive satin robe, holding one blank gold ingot with no markings or symbols. Warm, gentle, celebratory; no severe deity imagery, no armor, no weapon.

BOTTOM LEFT: playful ruby lion-dance cub mascot, original adorable creature design, premium ruby-red fur and satin details with pearl trim and champagne-gold accents, holding or presenting one tiny completely blank casino chip with no suit marks, letters, numbers, logos, or currency symbols. Friendly smile, lively compact pose, not frightening.

BOTTOM RIGHT: smiling emerald lucky cat mascot, original cute refined feline design, emerald-green accents with cream enamel, pearl white and champagne gold, positioned beside one clear faceted colorless diamond and a few completely blank gold coins. Coins have no text, portraits, letters, numerals, logos, or currency symbols. Full cat body visible and clearly separate from all other cells.

STYLE: premium polished 3D mobile game character renders, high-end luxury casino game production art, tactile satin cloth, realistic pearls, precious metals and gemstones, soft groomed fur, cute proportions with refined detail, cohesive with cream enamel, champagne gold and burgundy slot cabinets. Avoid plastic toy appearance and avoid flat vector styling.

LIGHTING AND MOOD: soft champagne studio key light, pearl-white fill, restrained gemstone sparkle, upbeat lucky celebration, warm, joyful, gentle, inviting rather than royal, stern, or solemn. No cast shadows on the background and no blue spill.

STRICT CONTENT: exactly four mascots total and no extra characters, companions, faces, spirits, or floating creatures. No text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, currency symbols, recognizable IP, detached body parts, transparent/checkerboard background, blue costume parts, blue gemstones, photoreal adult humans, armor, weapons, dark temple, excessive neon, or busy background. The final image is a clean exact 2x2 atlas on solid #0000FF.
